name: stat-cards
description: Totals above a list or on a dashboard. `Stat` is a label (`StatLabel`), a value (`StatValue`, formatted by the app, with `isLoading` and `isUnavailable` states), an optional `StatIcon` (a `soft` `IconTile`) and a `StatDescription`; `tone` (`default`, `success`, `warning`, `info`, `destructive`, `muted`) tints the icon and the value, and `size="lg"` enlarges the value. On its own, `Stat` has no surface, for several figures inside one card. The cards come in four kinds: `StatCard` (static), `StatCardButton` (runs `onPress` or opens a dialog as the child of a `DialogTrigger`), `StatCardLink` (navigates, e.g. to the list already filtered) and `StatCardToggle`, the selectable cards of a `StatCardGroup` — a react-aria `ToggleButtonGroup` that filters a list: `selectionMode="single"` behaves like radios, `"multiple"` like checkboxes, controlled by `selectedKeys`/`onSelectionChange` so it maps to a search param. `StatGrid` and `StatCardGroup` lay cards out in as many columns as fit, and their `i18n.labels` reach every value inside.
